title: Holding Two Ostomy Supply Program Enrollments, One per Stoma
content:
A customer may hold up to 2 Ostomy Supply Program enrollments at the same time, one for each stoma, because a customer with both a colostomy or ileostomy and a urostomy needs a separate appliance for each.

**Opening a second program.** A new ostomy program is opened only when the customer has no ostomy program of the same ostomy type in referral received, pending authorization, active or on hold. A closed program does not count.

**Changes for an existing stoma.** A new system, size or insurance for an existing stoma is written as a program change on that stoma's program, not as a new program.

**Tier of each program.** Each program carries its own tier from the coverage it bills; both programs of one customer normally bill the same primary coverage.

| Customer's existing programs (hypothetical) | Request | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| One active colostomy program | New urostomy program | May be opened (second program) |
| One active colostomy program | New colostomy program | Not opened; written as a program change |
| One closed urostomy program, one active colostomy program | New urostomy program | May be opened - the closed program does not count |
| One colostomy program on hold | New colostomy program | Not opened - a program on hold counts |
